name: godot_ssot_proxy
summary: Stdlib HTTP sidecar on port 8766 that exposes the Godot scene state as a queryable + commandable API to external callers (Replit-deployed apps, dApp, Meta Quest builds, Facebook Instant Games). Mediates via the existing cc_bridge.gd file queue at ~/.cc/godot_bridge.jsonl + scene snapshots at ~/.cc/scene_state/<scene_uid>.json + single-writer locks at ~/.cc/scene_locks/<scene_uid>.lock. Bearer-gated by freetier_gate.verify_token on every endpoint EXCEPT /healthz. Caller identity (user_id, domain, tier) propagates into every response and every crystal chain entry. POST /scene/{uid}/command acquires fcntl.flock LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB on the lock file, writes {writer_id, acquired_at, ttl_ms=2000} payload, appends a cc_godot_bridge_v1 packet to ~/.cc/godot_bridge.jsonl, crystal-anchors, releases the lock, and returns {ack, crystal, packet_id}. When the lock is held by another writer, 409 with retry_after_ms; stale locks (now - acquired_at >= ttl_ms) are stolen with a ConflictTrace appended to ~/.cc/conflict_log.jsonl AND a tier='ssot_conflict' crystal anchor. GET /events is a Server-Sent Events stream tailing ~/.cc/godot_bridge_outbound.jsonl, with 500ms poll and 30s heartbeats.
engine_pattern: Stdlib http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer (mirrors freetier_callback/server.py + model_api.py). Per-request handler verifies bearer via freetier_gate.verify_token, dispatches, crystal-anchors via inference_logger.log (tier='ssot_api', model='godot_proxy', source_file=caller=<user_id>@<domain>). Single-writer locks use fcntl.flock with LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB; stale locks (past ttl_ms) are force-stolen with a ConflictTrace record. SSE streams new lines from godot_bridge_outbound.jsonl every 500ms with 30s heartbeats.

endpoints.GET /scene/{scene_uid}/state: Read snapshot file ~/.cc/scene_state/{uid}.json — empty {} if missing
endpoints.POST /scene/{scene_uid}/command: Acquire flock → append cc_godot_bridge_v1 packet → crystal anchor → return {ack, crystal, packet_id}
endpoints.POST /symbols: Merge {name, kind, meta} entry into sym_index.json + crystal anchor

request_shape_command.writer_id: string — single-writer ID; falls back to caller.user_id

response_shape_command.crystal: blake3 hash of the InferenceRecord crystal anchor
response_shape_command.stale_steal: true if we stole a stale lock; ConflictTrace + ssot_conflict crystal also emitted

env_vars.SSOT_LOG: set to 'quiet' to suppress access log

filesystem_layout.~/.cc/scene_locks/<scene_uid>.lock: WRITE — sidecar acquires fcntl LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB + stamps {writer_id, acquired_at, ttl_ms}
filesystem_layout.~/.cc/godot_bridge.jsonl: APPEND — cc_godot_bridge_v1 packets (cc_bridge.gd polls; we never delete)
filesystem_layout.~/.cc/godot_bridge_outbound.jsonl: TAIL — Godot writes; SSE clients consume

single_writer_lock_semantics.fresh_held: BlockingIOError + existing.acquired_at within ttl_ms → 409 {error:'lock_held', current_writer, retry_after_ms}
single_writer_lock_semantics.stale_held: BlockingIOError + existing.acquired_at past ttl_ms → steal lock, append ConflictTrace, crystal-anchor tier='ssot_conflict'
single_writer_lock_semantics.release: fcntl LOCK_UN + close fd in finally

substrate: ~/.cc/inference_master_chain.jsonl (every API call → InferenceRecord tier='ssot_api'; conflict steals → tier='ssot_conflict')

inbound_callers: dApp /buy or other authenticated UI calls
Meta Quest builds (LAN call to Caddy → this sidecar)
outbound_calls: freetier_gate.verify_token (bearer middleware on every endpoint except /healthz)
inference_logger.log (every API call: tier='ssot_api'; lock steals: tier='ssot_conflict')
routing_connections.substrate_reads: Authorization / X-Freetier-Token request header; scene snapshots; sym_index; task_queue; master chain tail; outbound JSONL tail
routing_connections.substrate_writes: godot_bridge.jsonl (cc_bridge.gd will pick up); scene_locks; sym_index; conflict_log; crystal chain entries (via inference_logger)

guarantees: Bearer-gated — every endpoint except /healthz requires a valid freetier token
Crystal-audit-trail — every API call has a deterministic chain entry tying caller → endpoint → outcome
Single-writer scene mutation — fcntl.flock guarantees one writer at a time per scene_uid
Stale-lock recovery — locks older than ttl_ms are stolen with a ConflictTrace + crystal anchor (no permanent lockup)
Single-port — one stdlib server; no FastAPI dep
Per-caller audit — caller={user_id, domain, tier} written into source_file claim
Bridge-protocol-compatible — packets match cc_bridge.gd's cc_godot_bridge_v1 (cc_bridge picks them up without modification)
127.0.0.1-only — Caddy on droplet handles TLS termination
future_v2_hooks: Per-caller rate limiting based on TokenClaims.tier
Per-domain ACLs (e.g. trolln_tier can write, freetier read-only)
usage_example:
# Server:
python3 core/lib/godot_ssot_proxy.py serve --port 8766 --bind 127.0.0.1

# Public health check:
curl http://localhost:8766/healthz

# Read scene state (authed):
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <freetier_token>' http://localhost:8766/scene/test/state

# Send command (authed; single-writer locked):
curl -X POST http://localhost:8766/scene/test/command \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <freetier_token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"action":"spawn_entity","payload":{"prefab":"npc"},"writer_id":"replit_app_42"}'

# Tail outbound events (SSE):
curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer <freetier_token>' http://localhost:8766/events
